item9_correction_note: 2026-08-28 post-hoc correction (gazebo-testing, same session): the FIRST pass of this analysis compared rudder's Cl (roll-due-to-rudder) against the wide-deflection TXT's own raw Cl(delta_r) column, which produced 4 sign-flip WATCH results at |delta_r|=35/45deg. Root-caused via source read (plugins/aerodynamics/AeroModel.hh line ~271, docs/source_of_truth/aerodynamics/aero_v1_config.yaml lines ~485-495): this is NOT the runtime's actual reference - aero_v1_config.yaml's rudder.Cl_NOT_LOADED_disputed_sign_reference_only is explicitly not loaded by the plugin; the runtime instead derives its rudder-roll lookup as a bounded linear extension of lateral_directional.Cldr_per_rad (+0.0007/rad, UNRESOLVED_KEEP_CURRENT, a decision from a PRIOR stage, unrelated to and unchanged by this stage's own +/-10deg->+/-45deg multiplier rescale). Re-run using the CORRECT reference (CLDR_PER_RAD, see test script) below - all 10 rudder Cl points now PASS. This was a test-methodology gap in this test's own first-pass reference table, NOT a runtime/model.sdf/aero defect - raw measured values were unchanged, only the comparison reference was corrected. No aero coefficient, model.sdf control block, or any physics parameter was touched to produce this correction - only this test script's own comparison logic.
